resources.string: Lets CSearch Revamped take a screenshot when you tap the accessibility button, the Quick Settings tile or the assistant gesture, so you can circle something and search it. Nothing is captured unless you trigger it.
Circle or tap anything to search
Search, translate or copy the selection
No text found in the selection
No text found, opening image search instead
Enable the CSearch Revamped accessibility service first
Turn on "Use screenshot" in the assistant settings, or enable the accessibility service
Play or hum near the mic · %1$ds
Try again closer to the speaker
Microphone permission is needed for song search
The free anonymous limit was reached. Add a free AudD API token in CSearch Revamped settings.

Turn on the CSearch Revamped accessibility service. It only takes a screenshot when you trigger a search.\n\nIf Android says the setting is restricted: App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Set CSearch Revamped as your digital assistant app, then long-press home or the gesture bar to start a search.
Add the "Screen search" and "Song search" tiles to your Quick Settings panel.
Translate to (language code, e.g. en, bg, de)
AudD API token for song search (optional)
Song search uses the AudD recognition API. It works a few times a day without a token; get a free token at dashboard.audd.io for more.
